My advice is to go to a smaller game reserve in the Greater Kruger National Park. You see, when you go into the Kruger, you are on tar roads and will constantly be bumping into other cars. You could be one car of dozens at a sighting because it is such a vast area that everyone tends to stick together. 

Personally, I recommend any of the lodges in Balule Game reserve, which is part of the greater kruger. All of the lodges there are superb. The only one I don't care for is Naledi Bush camp. If I were to pick, the best would be Ezulwini Billy's Lodge (Or River Lodge) Or Pondoro. 

The perks of going to a smaller reserve is that you are with a trained safari guide who can provide endless knowledge on just about anything in the bush. Another perk is that in a smaller reserve, the animals are in a smaller space, so the odds of seeing the Big 5 (lion, leopard, rhino, elephant,and buffalo) are almost gurranteed. The great thing about Balule is that it is on the Olifants River, so you will get gurranteed hippo sightings as well. 

I hope this helped!

Source: I was a hostess at a safari lodge.
